summary: M6_2F_TESTER_BUILD (mode=build, 'do not yet run'). Entry gate verified in the state ledger before any work: M6-P1500 SIGNED, M6-P1501 PASS, M6-P1502 PASS (required predecessor), M6-P1503 RUNNING (this prompt, order 129). Authored exactly five official smoke files, one per bound smoke id (M6-SMK-004/005/006/010/015), each carrying the SMOKE_REGISTER scenario AND expected result VERBATIM (Vietnamese, diacritics intact) in its docstring, driving the M6.2F dashboard + data-quality layer via handle_dashboard_request / DataMart+ConsumedFacts / compute_metrics (14 CTR-015 KPIs) / DataQualityChecker+AdsDataQualityCheck, and reusing the shared conftest fixtures (make_measurement_event, make_conversion, make_verified_row, make_dashboard_deps, make_data_mart, dq_checker, measurement_store, attribution_materializer, audit). Every file includes negative / fail-closed companions (and non-vacuous positive controls): SMK-004 no-spend fail-closed ROAS None + DQ FAIL on a quote carrying revenue; SMK-005 draft materializes no revenue + DQ FAIL on a draft carrying revenue + a verified-order control; SMK-006 (the M6.2F dashboard-render leg, distinct from the carried M6.2E attribution smoke) absent-spend and unmapped-spend fail-closed + a two-order update case; SMK-010 no CRM/scale/trigger surface on the mart, deps hold only {mart}, view has no trigger handle, reading twice mutates nothing; SMK-015 verified-only-by-construction + DQ Verified-Revenue FAIL on quote/draft-as-revenue + a verified control. ACCEPTANCE CHECKS met: (1) one test per bound smoke id, scenario verbatim; (2) negative cases present in every file; (3) existing coder test patterns reused (tests/test_quote_not_revenue.py, test_order_draft_not_verified.py, test_dashboard_verified_only_revenue.py, test_dashboard_rejects_unverified_as_revenue.py, test_data_mart_support_view_only.py, test_data_quality_checker.py, test_kpi_formulas_verbatim.py) plus conftest fixtures. BUILD VALIDATION was collect-only (imports/collects, NO assertions executed) per the prompt, cache-free, no shell redirection: the five new files collect clean (per-file nodes 3,4,4,3,4 = 18 new) EXIT 0; the full staged suite collects to 273 (= 255 carried M6.2F baseline [239 carried M6.2E tree + 16 coder dashboard/DQ leg tests] + 18 new smoke nodes) EXIT 0, total obtained via an in-process pytest_collection_finish tally (harness clips a long terminal summary). A read-only adversarial static-verification workflow (6 agents: one verifier per smoke file tracing EVERY assertion through the frozen implementation + a completeness critic) returned all-CLEAN, 0 errors: all ~47 assertions predicted PASS at run time with cited source basis, scenario/expected verbatim confirmed, PII-clean and boundary-clean on every file, and the critic confirmed exactly the five ids covered with one verbatim primary + a negative each, no self-certification, no state write. One design subtlety independently confirmed by the verifiers and mirrored from the coder's own reference tests: a quote-only dashboard's Revenue Verified shows 0.0 with no evidence ref, so overall_data_quality would be FAIL there; SMK-004/005 therefore deliberately do NOT assert overall=PASS, while SMK-006/015 (which seed a verified row) correctly assert PASS. TEST_MANIFEST.md rebuilt for M6.2F (binding table, per-smoke verbatim sections, fixtures, boundary, exit-gate legs L1-L6, execution plan for M6-P1504). GOVERNANCE POSTURE UNCHANGED AND IMMUTABLE: global_gateway_state=BLOCKED, production_flag=OFF, external_send=OFF, DASHBOARD_ALERT_THRESHOLDS_DEFINED=False (M6-OD-002 OPEN), HASH_POLICY_RATIFIED=False, SCALE_MODEL_RATIFIED=False (M6-OD-005 OPEN). No application code changed, no migration applied, no external call, no order-state/pricing/CRM-send/commission/scale/flag-flip, no write to 04-artifacts/state/. All ids synthetic; no raw secret/PII (the 'revenue on a non-verified event' negatives are fabricated in-memory events with synthetic ids fed straight to the DQ checker). status=PASS is an honest TESTER self-report of a completed, collect-validated, statically-verified BUILD; it does NOT execute the smokes and does NOT advance any gate. Formal execution is M6-P1504; the runner EVIDENCE_GATE and the slice Judge decide closure.
